faq.title: Questions & Answers
faq.q1: Can I do everything from my phone?
faq.a1: Yes! Robi is designed to work entirely from your smartphone. Create quotes, get them signed on the spot, and convert them to invoices in seconds. The app is available on App Store and Play Store.
faq.q2: Can I know if my client opened my quote?
faq.a2: Yes. When you send a quote for remote signature, Robi shows you how many times the client opened it and the time of each view. Perfect for following up at the right moment!
faq.q3: Can I customize my invoices and quotes?
faq.a3: Absolutely. Add your logo, colors, choose from several professional templates, and include up to 5 photos in your quotes (job site, materials, etc.).
faq.a4: Yes. From your phone or computer, you can fill in your VAT certificates in a few clicks, then have your clients sign them electronically.
faq.a5: Yes, a real team answers your questions within 24 hours. No chatbots — real humans who understand your freelance challenges.
faq.q6: Can I manage multiple companies from the same account?
faq.a6: Yes. Robi lets you manage as many companies as you need from a single account. Switch between businesses in one click.
faq.q7: I'm a sole trader. Does the VAT exemption notice appear automatically?
faq.a7: Yes. When you set VAT to 0% on a quote or invoice, the VAT exemption notice appears automatically on the document.
faq.q8: How long does it take to create my first invoice?
faq.a8: Less than 30 seconds. Just tell Robi what you want to invoice — it generates the document instantly. All you have to do is approve and send.
faq.q9: Are my invoices compliant with legal requirements?
faq.a9: Yes. Every invoice generated by Robi includes all mandatory details: sequential numbering, VAT, company registration number, issue date, and payment terms. You're fully compliant.
faq.a10: You can cancel with one click, no commitment. Your data remains accessible in read-only mode for 12 months.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Robi AI
privacy.description: Privacy policy and personal data protection at Robi AI.
privacy.introContent: At Robi AI Technologies ("we", "our", "Robi AI"), we take the protection of your personal data very seriously. This policy describes how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our invoicing service.
privacy.dataCollectedContent:
As part of our service, we collect:

**Identification data**: name, email address, phone number
**Professional data**: business name, registration number, business address, industry
**Billing data**: client information, invoiced amounts, payment history
**Technical data**: IP address, browser type, pages visited, session duration
**Payment data**: processed exclusively by Stripe and PayPal (we do not store your banking data)
privacy.purposeContent:
Your data is used to:
- Provide and manage our invoicing service
- Process your payments and subscriptions
- Send service-related notifications
- Improve our products and services
- Provide customer support
- Comply with our legal and regulatory obligations
privacy.legalBasisContent:
The processing of your data is based on:
- **Contract performance**: to provide the service you subscribed to
- **Consent**: for marketing communications
- **Legitimate interest**: to improve our services
- **Legal obligations**: invoice retention (10 years)
privacy.retentionContent:
- **Account data**: retained during your subscription + 12 months after closure
- **Billing data**: 10 years (legal requirement)
- **Technical data**: 13 months maximum
- **Cookies**: 13 months maximum
privacy.rightsContent:
Under GDPR, you have the following rights:
- **Right of access**: obtain a copy of your data
- **Right to rectification**: correct inaccurate data
- **Right to erasure**: request deletion of your data
- **Right to portability**: receive your data in a structured format
- **Right to object**: object to the processing of your data
- **Right to restriction**: restrict the processing of your data

To exercise these rights: privacy@robi.ai
privacy.securityContent:
We implement technical and organizational security measures:
- AES-256 encryption of data at rest
- TLS 1.3 encryption in transit
- Two-factor authentication available
- European hosting (GDPR compliant)
- Regular security audits
- Least privilege access principle
privacy.cookiesContent:
We use cookies for:
- **Essential cookies**: site functionality and authentication
- **Analytics cookies**: understanding service usage (via a privacy-respecting tool)
- **Preference cookies**: remembering your choices (language, theme)

You can manage your cookie preferences at any time.

75001 Paris, France

cgv.title: Terms of Sale | Robi AI
cgv.description: Terms of sale for the Robi AI service.
cgv.objectContent: These Terms of Sale govern the contractual relationship between Robi AI Technologies SAS and any user subscribing to a paid plan on the Robi AI invoicing platform.
cgv.offersContent:
Robi AI offers the following plans:

- **Free version**: 2 free invoices or quotes, no commitment and no credit card required
- **Pro Weekly**: €4.99/week, unlimited access to all features
- **Pro Annual**: €89/year (i.e. €7.42/month, 2 months free), unlimited access to all features
- **Launch offer**: €59 lifetime access, reserved for the first 1,000 users

All prices are shown in euros including tax. Robi AI reserves the right to modify its pricing with 30 days' notice.
cgv.paymentContent:
Payments are processed securely by **Stripe**. Accepted payment methods include credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express).

For recurring subscriptions (Pro Weekly and Pro Annual), payment is automatic at each billing cycle. Users can update their payment information at any time from their dashboard.
cgv.withdrawalContent:
In accordance with French consumer law (Articles L.221-18 et seq. of the Consumer Code), you have a **14-day period** from the date of subscription to exercise your right of withdrawal, without having to justify any reason or pay any penalties.

To exercise this right, contact us at: contact@robi.ai

Refunds will be issued within 14 days of receiving your request, using the same payment method as the original transaction.
cgv.durationContent:
Robi AI subscriptions are **commitment-free**. Users can cancel their subscription at any time with **one click** from their dashboard.

- **Pro Weekly**: cancellation takes effect at the end of the current week
- **Pro Annual**: cancellation takes effect at the end of the current annual period
- **Lifetime offer**: permanent access, no cancellation needed

After cancellation, data remains accessible in read-only mode for 12 months.
cgv.ipContent:
Documents (invoices, quotes, certificates) created by the user through Robi AI **belong entirely to the user**. Robi AI claims no ownership rights over content generated by its users.

However, the Robi AI platform, its source code, design, trademarks and logos remain the exclusive property of Robi AI Technologies SAS.
cgv.liabilityContent:
Robi AI is an **invoicing assistance tool**. The user remains solely responsible for the content of their invoices, their legal and tax compliance, and their transmission to clients.

Robi AI shall not be held liable for:
- Errors or omissions in documents generated by the user
- Tax or legal consequences related to the use of the service
- Indirect damages, data loss or lost profits
cgv.dataContent:
Robi AI is **GDPR compliant** (General Data Protection Regulation). Your data is:
- **Hosted in France** on secure servers
- **Encrypted** in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256)
- **Never sold** or shared with third parties for commercial purposes

For more details, see our Privacy Policy.
cgv.lawContent: These Terms of Sale are governed by **French law**. In the event of a dispute, the parties agree to seek an amicable solution. Failing that, the **courts of Paris** shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
